changelog:
- Operates Hacker News through the OOMOL `hackernews` connector via the `oo` CLI.
- Supports reading story feeds including top, best, new, Ask HN, Show HN, and jobs.
- Retrieves individual items, bounded nested comment trees, max item IDs, updates, and public user profiles.
- Searches Hacker News posts using Algolia full-text search and date-based latest-post queries.
- Uses live connector schemas before execution so payloads match current action contracts.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`
